title: The small tensor coproduct of field extensions is nontrivial
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $J$ be a small set [def-weil-size-convention]. For every $j\in J$ let $L_j/k$ be a field extension with structural embedding $a_j:k\to L_j$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Let $A$ be a coproduct of the commutative $k$-algebras $L_j$ in the category of commutative $k$-algebras (equivalently, the small tensor product $\bigotimes_{j\in J,k}L_j$), with its canonical maps $\iota_j:L_j\to A$. Then $A$ is nontrivial. This includes the empty family, for which $A$ is canonically $k$.
